---
title: "EXAMPLE_LABEL"
subtitle: "EXAMPLE_REGIONS · EXAMPLE_WINDOW_START to EXAMPLE_WINDOW_END"
description: "EXAMPLE_N_STATIONS checkpoint stations · EXAMPLE_WINDOW_START to EXAMPLE_WINDOW_END"
date: EXAMPLE_WINDOW_START
author: "USGS / SECOORA ERDDAP"
format: html
params:
  cruise_id: "EXAMPLE_CRUISE_ID"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

<!--
This is the template used to generate a report for each entry (cruise or event)
in data/keys_checkpoints_flat.csv (see ../generate_batch_qmds.R). Entries are
keyed on cruise_id; report_label supplies the display title and falls back to the
cruise_id when blank.
-->

```{r setup}
#| output: false

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(htmltools)
library(leaflet)
library(readr)

source(here::here("R", "ndbc_time.R"))
source(here::here("R", "fetch_ndbc_observations.R"))
source(here::here("R", "plot_ndbc_field.R"))
source(here::here("R", "plot_cruise_timeseries.R"))
source(here::here("R", "cruise_reports.R"))

report <- build_cruise_report(params$cruise_id)

salinity_palette <- c(
  "#2166ac", "#67a9cf", "#d1e5f0",
  "#fddbc7", "#ef8a62", "#b2182b"
)
temperature_palette <- c(
  "#313695", "#74add1", "#abd9e9",
  "#fee090", "#f46d43", "#a50026"
)

window_label <- sprintf(
  "%s to %s",
  format(report$info$window_start),
  format(report$info$window_end)
)
regions_label <- paste(report$info$regions, collapse = ", ")
target_time_label <- format_ndbc_time(report$salinity$target_time)
```

**`r report$info$label`** covers **`r nrow(report$info$stations)`** checkpoint stations in the **`r regions_label`** during **`r window_label`**. The interpolated fields below approximate conditions on **`r target_time_label`** — the midpoint of the window — from the NDBC buoy network. Time series show the full record at the NDBC buoy nearest each checkpoint station, with the window shaded.

## Checkpoint stations & nearest buoys

```{r station-map}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6
plot_cruise_station_map(report$matched_stations)
```

```{r station-table}
report$matched_stations |>
  select(
    Station = station,
    Region = region,
    `Nearest buoy` = nearest_station,
    `Distance (km)` = nearest_distance_km
  ) |>
  mutate(`Distance (km)` = sprintf("%.1f", `Distance (km)`)) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Interpolated fields

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Salinity

```{r salinity-field}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6
if (is.null(report$salinity_field) || nrow(report$salinity_field) == 0) {
  tags$p(
    class = "cruise-field-unavailable",
    "Interpolated salinity field unavailable for this cruise window (insufficient buoy coverage or interpolation failure)."
  )
} else {
  plot_ndbc_field(
    report$salinity_field,
    report$salinity$snapshot,
    value_col = "salinity",
    legend_title = "Salinity (PSU)",
    popup_suffix = " PSU",
    palette = salinity_palette
  )
}
```

### Temperature

```{r temperature-field}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6
if (is.null(report$temperature_field) || nrow(report$temperature_field) == 0) {
  tags$p(
    class = "cruise-field-unavailable",
    "Interpolated temperature field unavailable for this cruise window (insufficient buoy coverage or interpolation failure)."
  )
} else {
  plot_ndbc_field(
    report$temperature_field,
    report$temperature$snapshot,
    value_col = "temperature",
    legend_title = "Temperature (°C)",
    popup_suffix = " °C",
    palette = temperature_palette
  )
}
```

:::

## Nearest-buoy time series

```{r buoy-timeseries}
#| output: asis
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 3.5

for (i in seq_len(nrow(report$unique_buoys))) {
  buoy <- report$unique_buoys[i, ]
  matched_names <- report$matched_stations |>
    filter(nearest_station_id == buoy$nearest_station_id) |>
    pull(station)

  cat(sprintf("\n\n### %s\n\n", buoy$nearest_station))
  cat(sprintf(
    "Nearest buoy for checkpoint station(s): %s\n\n",
    paste(matched_names, collapse = ", ")
  ))

  sal_df <- report$salinity$series |> filter(station_id == buoy$nearest_station_id)
  temp_df <- report$temperature$series |> filter(station_id == buoy$nearest_station_id)

  sal_plot <- plot_cruise_timeseries(
    sal_df, "salinity", "Salinity (PSU)", buoy$nearest_station,
    report$info$window_start, report$info$window_end,
    line_color = "#08519c"
  )
  temp_plot <- plot_cruise_timeseries(
    temp_df, "temperature", "Temperature (°C)", buoy$nearest_station,
    report$info$window_start, report$info$window_end,
    line_color = "#a50026"
  )

  if (!is.null(sal_plot)) {
    print(sal_plot)
  } else {
    cat("No salinity data available for this buoy during the cruise window.\n\n")
  }

  if (!is.null(temp_plot)) {
    print(temp_plot)
  } else {
    cat("No temperature data available for this buoy during the cruise window.\n\n")
  }
}
```
